$comment: The style block from art-breakdown.md ('The style block'), as the file scripts/lookdev/leonardo.mjs reads and restates in full in every generation call. subjectLock was added after the Director's 2026-10-20 test, where a generic prompt drew a campus.
technique: photographic concept render, first-person, shallow depth of field at the far edge
subject: architectural drafting: thin luminous linework, translucent paper-thin volumes, physical drafting objects
subjectLock: the plan is the wings, rooms and fixtures of a software product, drawn as an architect's site plan; no buildings, no trees, no landscape, no readable text or labels
